label.company_type_evidence: Indian consumer-retail product company; the PM owns supply chain product surface end-to-end: "Own features and modules across supply chain products end-to-end".
label.why_it_matters: Primary domain (supply chain), real outcome metrics named (OTIF, inventory turns, fill rate, cost-to-serve), but sub-level at 3-5 years. Tests that domain fit and level are scored separately rather than collapsing into one number.
